page_title: STU 2-3 EIN | Stuttgart v Eintracht Frankfurt 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+9' Celebrations are cut short for Stuttgart as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
90+8' Wait! Referee Felix Zwayer has indicated he is going to review the Stuttgart goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
90+7' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
90+5' Stuttgart failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
90+5' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
90+4' The attendance for today's match is 60000.
90+2' Felix Zwayer rightly pulls out a yellow card and shows it to Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.

90' 2 - 3 Angelo Stiller feeds the ball through to Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 2:3!
90' Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart) received a pass out of defence and immediately attempted a long-range shot, but a defender bravely blocked the effort.
87' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
86' None of the Stuttgart players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
86' 1 - 3 Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) receives a brilliant pass and hammers the ball inside the left post. It couldn't have gone in a better place. What a beautiful long-range goal.
86' The corner is swung in but Stuttgart can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
85' That's the end of the game for Nathaniel Brown, who is replaced by Igor Matanovic (Eintracht Frankfurt).
85' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
83' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
81' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
78' Nnamdi Collins will be replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes onto the pitch so that Hugo Ekitike can be given a rest.
75' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Ermedin Demirovic is replaced by Nick Woltemade (VfB Stuttgart).
75' Substitution. Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart) on for Anthony Rouault.
74' The resulting set piece from Stuttgart is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
74' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart).

74' Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away.
73' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
70' What a chance that is! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the crossbar!
69' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
67' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) quickly picks up the rebound and shoots towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save to deny him.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Stuttgart comes to nothing.

62' 0 - 3 Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes inside the left post and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 0:3.
61' Sebastian Hoeness decides to make a substitution. Atakan Karazor will be replaced by El Bilal Toure (VfB Stuttgart).
61' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Justin Diehl (VfB Stuttgart) is coming onto the pitch as Fabian Rieder cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' A cross from a corner kick by Eintracht Frankfurt is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
59' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

59' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out. The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt have been awarded a corner kick.
57' Felix Zwayer shows the yellow card to Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) for a heavy challenge.
56' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Hugo Larsson as he is replaced by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt).
55' 0 - 2 Goal! Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 0:2.
54' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) receives a cross in the box and attempts to shoot, but mishits the ball and misses the goal.
52' An attempted cross from Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared.
50' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) shows good awareness inside the box, but his attempt is stopped by the goalkeeper.
49' Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
48' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
46' It's time for a substitution. Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Junior Dina Ebimbe.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' A wild pass somehow finds Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) in space, he steadies himself and shoots from mid-range but sends it just over the bar.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' 0 - 1 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 0:1.
43' Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
42' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) plays a through ball but overhits it.
41' A crossfield pass from Junior Dina Ebimbe (Eintracht Frankfurt) fails to find any of his teammates.
39' Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alexander Nubel intercepts the ball.
38' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) hits a good looking first-time shot from the edge of the box, but it goes narrowly over the bar.

36' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Kevin Trapp.
34' Arthur Theate (Eintracht Frankfurt) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
33' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Stuttgart.
32' A raking crossfield pass from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) lacks accuracy and the opposition gain possession. Stuttgart have a corner.
29' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement. Stuttgart earn a free kick.
28' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
28' It looks like Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) saw red with that tackle. Felix Zwayer won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Stuttgart have a free kick.
27' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Kevin Trapp.
26' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) duly receives a yellow card.
24' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
22' Penalty saved! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) sends the penalty towards the bottom left corner, but Kevin Trapp pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
22' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
22' Referee Felix Zwayer is happy with his original decision after the VAR review. It’s a PENALTY to Stuttgart!
21' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Stuttgart, he's going to review using VAR.
20' A player from Eintracht Frankfurt pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle. Stuttgart are awarded a penalty!
18' What a chance that is! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header crashes off the crossbar!
17' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
15' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) commits a rough foul. Felix Zwayer stops the game and makes a call.
14' A cross into the box from Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) is cleared.
12' The ball is cleared after Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
10' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Kevin Trapp.
9' Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
7' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.

5' Fabian Rieder (VfB Stuttgart) produces an inaccurate low pass into the box that is blocked by the one of the defenders. If this pass had slipped through, the ball would have probably ended up in the back of the net.

4' Omar Marmoush (Eintracht Frankfurt) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the left post.
3' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
2' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Eintracht Frankfurt will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Felix Zwayer.
